newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin prices seen lower in 1997, '98 - MIER.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin prices seen lower in 1997, '98 - MIER.

text.p: Malaysian tin prices are expected to fall in 1997 and 1998 due to lower export earnings, the Malaysian Institute of Economic Research (MIER) said on Tuesday.

The export unit value of tin is expected to average 15,500 ringgit ($6,129) a tonne in 1996 and decline to 15,100 ringgit in 1997 and 15,000 ringgit in 1998, the government-backed institute said in a review of the country's various economic sectors.
MIER said lower export volumes led to a 3.1 percent fall in tin export receipts for the first nine months of 1996, compared to a 11.9 percent rise in the same 1995 period.
Major export destinations were Japan, the Netherlands, South Korea and Germany.
